info.title: Salaam operator socket
info.description: The private control socket a Salaam daemon serves to AgentPod's node-agent on the same host: HTTP/1.1 over the Unix socket `<state>/operator.sock`, owner-only, no credential (salaam:src/service/routes.ts operatorRoutes; agentpod:apps/node-agent/internal/salaam/client.go, work.go, mcp.go, skills.go). This document holds the 24 `POST /v1/agentpod/<action>` routes and the 3 reads the node-agent makes; the socket's other routes are Salaam's own. Every body is JSON of at most 1 MiB. A refusal is code-error.v1, `{code, error}`, for local IPC only (phase 4, ruling 1): the node-agent reads only `code`, and only a code of at most 64 characters. Every AgentPod route first needs the daemon started with reviewed AgentPod pins (`authority_disabled` otherwise). An unknown `/v1/agentpod/<action>` with a `request_id` answers 404 `not_found`. Each operation's `x-treaty-error-codes` lists the codes its handler and the functions it calls name; Salaam's codes are in contracts/error-codes.json.

servers.description: Any host name: the client dials `<state>/operator.sock`, a Unix socket in the daemon's private state directory.

Binding.description: The authority binding AgentPod's node issues for one station occupancy and run (salaam:src/core/agentpod-protocol.ts agentpodBinding; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-authority.ts SalaamAuthority; the node-agent's Go `Binding` refuses unknown fields). Closed: Salaam compares it canonically, so an extra key is refused. `station_key` is `salaam:` and the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of `workspace`, and organization, node, station key and workspace must equal the daemon's pins file; neither rule is a JSON Schema rule.

WorkBinding.description: A binding strict work accepts: a SuperPipeline run (`run_` and at least six letters or digits), and no control character in any string (salaam:src/core/agentpod-work-protocol.ts; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-work.ts WorkAuthority).

ApprovalRule.description: An agent's standing "Always allow" rule (salaam:src/agentpod/authority.ts approvalRules). Ids are lower-case UUIDs.

ApprovalRules.description: 1 to 16 rules with distinct ids (`x-uniqueBy`). Absent means none.

AuthorityStatus.description: An admission's state (salaam:src/agentpod/authority.ts status). `binding_digest` is the SHA-256 of the canonical binding; `expires_at` is epoch milliseconds. Salaam always sends `continued_from`; AgentPod's zod and Go struct allow it absent, for an older daemon.

Admission.description: An admission's state and the station's ACP credential: base64url HMAC-SHA-256 of the admission id under the daemon's control key (salaam:src/agentpod/authority.ts admit, token).

McpAssignment.description: The node's managed MCP assignment for one admitted session (salaam:src/mcp/protocol.ts mcpAssignment; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-mcp.ts SalaamMcpAssignment). Private node control data: it carries the proxy key. Beyond this shape, both sides require each URL to be canonical, its station segment to decode to `binding.station_id`, its digest segment to be the binding's digest, its last segment to name its server (`hub` for agentpod), and every server to share one origin and one key; `fixtures/agentpod-salaam/salaam-mcp-v1.json` holds those cases.

McpAdmission.description: The managed MCP readiness receipt (salaam:src/mcp/protocol.ts mcpAdmissionView; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-mcp.ts SalaamMcpAdmission). It names no URL and no key.

Attached.description: What an authenticated admission is bound to (salaam:src/service/control.ts attach). `work_control` is present for a SuperPipeline run when strict progression is on; `managed_mcp` when the daemon has a managed MCP profile, null before an assignment.

RestoreReceipt.description: A restore's receipt, replayed exactly for the same request (salaam:src/agentpod/station-restore.ts restoreFiles). `partial` names the path it stopped at in `stopped_at`.

Checkpoint.description: One completed step's checkpoint, from the run's own recorded station writes (salaam:src/agentpod/station-checkpoints.ts StationCheckpoint). `tree_digest` is empty when the run wrote nothing.

CheckpointDiff.description: What restoring a checkpoint would do to each file the run wrote, against the live workspace (salaam:src/agentpod/station-checkpoints.ts diff). Unchanged files are left out; `writes` is exactly what a restore with this `restore_digest` writes.

WorkActivity.description: One tool step for the card's activity, oldest first, at most 64 (salaam:src/agentpod/work-activity.ts). Observation only.

BoardReadRequest.description: A board read the agent is waiting on, for the owner to serve (salaam:src/runtime/board-reads.ts pending). Salaam's ids are UUIDs; AgentPod's hub takes any id of at most 64 characters. `card` and `attempts` take no arguments, `library_search` one `query` of 1 to 500 characters, `library_get` one `item_id` (`itm_` and 16 hex characters).

WorkStatus.description: The admitted task's view with the work fields beside it (salaam:src/agentpod/work.ts status). The task view's own fields (state, steps, runtime and the rest) are Salaam's task view and are not restated here. `plan` is the ACP plan update for the steps, null for none. `board_reads` is present only when reads are pending; `settlement_ready` only when a stopped run may be retired as a known-effects failure, else `settlement_refused` says which guard refused, for a revoked run.

ProgressReceipt.description: A bounded progression grant, replayed for the same work request (salaam:src/agentpod/work.ts progress).

SettlementRequest.description: Explicit terminal recovery of a stopped run (salaam:src/service/work.ts settle, fail, abandon; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-work-settlement.ts SalaamWorkSettlement). Closed. The ids are UUIDs as AgentPod sends them; Salaam's handler checks only 1 to 128 characters.

ExpiryRequest.description: Recovery of a run stopped on an expired, unapplied approval (salaam:src/service/work.ts expire; SalaamWorkExpiry).

SettlementReceipt.description: Work that never dispatched, settled (SalaamWorkSettlementReceipt, strict: AgentPod refuses another key).

FailureReceipt.description: Work stopped with known effects, retired as a failure with its history kept (SalaamWorkFailureReceipt).

AbandonReceipt.description: Local success the producer never recorded, retired as historical evidence, never producer success (SalaamWorkAbandonReceipt).

ExpiryReceipt.description: Work stopped on an expired approval that was never applied (SalaamWorkExpiryReceipt).

TraceReceipt.description: The work root's child trace context; the original context wins after a reconnect (salaam:src/execution/trace.ts bindWorkTrace). Correlation only: `authority` is always false.

CompletionReceipt.description: A fresh protected verification of the succeeded task (salaam:src/agentpod/work.ts completion; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-work-completion.ts, strict).

BoardReadAnswer.description: The owner's answer to one board read, relayed by AgentPod's hub (salaam:src/runtime/board-reads.ts answer; agentpod:apps/hub/src/services/bridge/salaam-board-reads.ts). Closed. Salaam bounds `text` at 262144 UTF-8 bytes and `error` at 2048; JSON Schema counts characters, so the byte bounds are Salaam's check. The hub cuts `text` at 204800 characters.

BoardRead.description: The board read after the answer (salaam:src/runtime/board-reads.ts view).

WorkDecisionDetail.description: What a person approving is shown (salaam:src/agentpod/work-decision-protocol.ts; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-work-decision.ts SalaamApprovalDetail). `preview_truncated` is optional only for an offer saved before it existed; Salaam's builder always sets it.

WorkDecision.description: One open approval of the run, offered for a decision (salaam:src/agentpod/work-decision-protocol.ts workDecision; SalaamWorkDecision). Closed: AgentPod's hub re-hashes the parsed decision, so a key it dropped would change `decision_digest`. Options are approve, then approve-run and always when offered, then deny, in that order. `expires_at` is epoch milliseconds.

WorkDecisionAnswer.description: A person's answer to an offered decision (workDecisionAnswer; SalaamWorkDecisionAnswer). `decision` is the offer exactly as saved and `decision_digest` its SHA-256; `answered_at` is UTC with a `Z`.

WorkDecisionReceipt.description: The answer applied (salaam:src/agentpod/work-decisions.ts answer). `grant_id` names the run grant an approve-run created.

WorkIdentity.description: The card's work: board, card and stage as the trusted producer asserts them, and the SHA-256 of the canonical work input and task plan.

WorkAdmission.description: A card's work admission (salaam:src/core/agentpod-work-protocol.ts agentpodWorkAdmission; agentpod:packages/contract/src/salaam-work.ts SalaamWorkAdmission). `fixtures/agentpod-salaam/salaam-work-v1.json` holds its cases and the comparison rules against an expected binding and a saved request.

TaskPlan.description: The fully expanded task plan (salaam:src/tasks/work.ts parse). Salaam refuses a plan its own parser does not return byte for byte (canonically), so the parser is the rule: its policy for acceptance checks, limits, a completion gate and team steps is Salaam's and is not restated here. Treaty pins the keys every plan carries.

WorkPayload.description: Admitting a card's work (salaam:src/service/work.ts admit; agentpod:apps/node-agent/internal/salaam/work.go WorkPayload). AgentPod bounds `input` at 512 KiB and `plan` at 256 KiB.

WorkReceipt.description: The task admitted for the card, never success or permission to run (salaam:src/agentpod/work.ts AgentPodWorkReceipt). The node-agent requires `plan_revision` 1 and the session, request and binding digest of its own admission.

Health.description: The daemon's health (salaam:src/service/system.ts health). The fields AgentPod's node-agent reads are pinned (agentpod:apps/node-agent/internal/salaam/client.go ObserveHealth, mcp.go AssignMCP, observe.go ObserveConfiguration); the rest is Salaam's own. A healthy daemon bound to AgentPod has `agentpod_config` set; `managed_mcp.profile_digest` is what an MCP assignment must name. AgentPod also reads `tools_user`, which Salaam's health does not send: the user tools run as is `tool_execution.user`.

Session.description: A session as the supervisor inspects it (salaam:src/core/protocol.ts Session), with the picker summary beside it. AgentPod reads `id` and `cwd`.

ContextInventory.description: A session's reviewed context admission (salaam:src/runtime/context-admission.ts inspect; agentpod:apps/node-agent/internal/salaam/skills.go SkillInventory). `empty` has revision 0 and a null digest; otherwise the digest is set. A skill entry also carries `skill_id` and `bundle_digest`.
